description: 1 if the check connected, authenticated and validated the FreeSWITCH responses during this run; 0 otherwise.
The time in seconds that FreeSWITCH has been running.
The number of channels that currently exist in FreeSWITCH. This is a channel count and not a call count; a bridged call typically has two or more channels.

The number of sessions that currently exist in FreeSWITCH (the first number of the "N session(s) - peak P" line of ``show status``). A session is one channel in this FreeSWITCH, so it equals freeswitch.channels.active on every sample observed; it is a core-reported value rather than a count of listed channels.

The highest number of concurrent sessions FreeSWITCH has had since the current process started (the "peak P" of the "N session(s) - peak P" line of ``show status``). A high-water mark that never decreases until FreeSWITCH restarts; it is not a rolling-window value. The separate "last 5min" figure is not reported because it resets on fixed five-minute boundaries.

The cumulative number of sessions FreeSWITCH created since the current process started ("N session(s) since startup" of ``show status``), submitted so the Agent reports the increase per interval. A 0 sample precedes it after a detected restart. Sessions of failed call attempts are included.

The maximum number of concurrent sessions that FreeSWITCH reports it will accept (the "N session(s) max" line of ``show status``, set by max-sessions). Constant until FreeSWITCH is reconfigured and restarted.
The maximum number of new sessions per second that FreeSWITCH accepts (sessions-per-second in switch.conf, the "out of max M" part of the rate line of ``show status``). Constant until reconfigured.
The number of SIP registrations FreeSWITCH currently holds, from ``show registrations count``. Counted across all profiles; no per-profile or per-user breakdown.

The number of bridged (connected) calls: channel pairs currently bridged, from ``show bridged_calls``. Only reported when collect_bridged_calls is enabled (off by default). Not a count of channels or of all calls.
The time in seconds that one run of the check took to collect from FreeSWITCH.
The number of failed collection runs. Tagged by error_type: connect or timeout or auth or protocol or parse.
